title: Wendell and the Contact
author: Quentin Winterbourne
blurb: Lena Vasquez, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
